name: Jason Duval
subtitle: Playable protagonist
summary: One of the two playable leads. An Army veteran from a family of grifters who has settled into the Leonida Keys, working for the local drug-running crowd and telling himself an easy life is still possible.

facts.text: Grew up around hustlers and crooks; joined the Army to put a rough adolescence behind him, then drifted back into the family trade — running product for the Keys' drug operators.
Rockstar's one-line pitch for him is that he wants an easy life but keeps finding things get harder — the setup for him wanting out.
Lives in a trailer on Brian Heder's property in the Keys, helping with Brian's business in exchange.
Shares the story with Lucia; the player can control both, together or separately, switching between them.
The Extended Look shows him running errands for Boobie Ike, robbing gas stations and working as hired muscle at a corporate party.

name: Lucia Caminos
subtitle: Playable protagonist
summary: The series' first female lead in a mainline game. Raised to fight by her father, she went to prison protecting her family and comes out determined to only make smart moves — right up until she meets Jason.

facts.text: Her father taught her to fight from the time she could walk, and life has kept testing her since; standing up for her family is what put her in the Leonida Penitentiary.
Got out of prison through sheer luck rather than good behaviour, and has resolved to play it smart from here.
Grew up in Liberty City before ending up in Leonida.
The first non-optional female protagonist in the series' main entries.
The Extended Look reportedly opens her side of the story with a prison prologue.

name: Cal Hampton
subtitle: Jason's friend
summary: A conspiracy-minded friend of Jason's who also works around Brian's operation. Happiest at home, screens up, watching the world fall apart from a safe distance.

facts.text: Described by Rockstar as Jason's friend and a fellow associate of Brian Heder.
Feels safest at home behind a computer, convinced the government is listening — and nobody around to tell him he's wrong.

name: Boobie Ike
subtitle: Vice City businessman
summary: A Vice City legend who turned street money into a real business empire — property, a strip club and a record label — and still carries himself like the neighbourhood's favourite uncle.

facts.text: Built a business empire on the streets of Vice City, spanning real estate, a strip club and a recording studio.
Co-owns Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest.
In the Extended Look, one mission has Jason collecting from a drug lab on Boobie's behalf when a police raid hits.

name: Dre'Quan Priest
subtitle: Only Raw Records
summary: A hustler with an ear for talent who runs Only Raw Records with Boobie Ike and is betting the label on Real Dimez to get him somewhere bigger.

facts.text: Rockstar frames him as a hustler with a knack for spotting talent.
Signed the duo Real Dimez to Only Raw Records and sees the label as his ticket out of small-time hustling.

name: Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe and Roxy)
subtitle: Rap duo
summary: Two friends from high school who rapped, hustled and posted their way to a viral following, then signed with Only Raw Records.

facts.text: Bae-Luxe and Roxy have been friends since high school and built their following by rapping, hustling and going viral online.
Signed to Only Raw Records, the label run by Dre'Quan Priest and Boobie Ike.

name: Raul Bautista
subtitle: Bank robber
summary: A charming, experienced bank robber who is always assembling his next crew — and whose jobs keep getting riskier.

facts.text: Rockstar describes him as a seasoned bank robber perpetually on the lookout for a new crew.
Charismatic, but each score he lines up carries more risk than the last.

name: Brian Heder
subtitle: Drug runner, Jason's landlord
summary: An old-school Keys smuggler from the 1980s heyday who lets Jason live on his land in exchange for a hand with the business.

facts.text: A classic drug runner from the Keys' glory days; still moving product with help from Jason and Cal.
Lets Jason stay in a trailer on his property in return for help with his operation.
Voiced by Stephen Root, according to press reports.
